projects.statement: Calm luxury at the lowest point on Earth.
brand: At the lowest point on Earth, where the stillness of the Dead Sea meets the glow of salt under the sun, Salt Beach was born.

More than a beach, Salt Beach is a private VIP destination designed for those who seek calm, comfort, and refined exclusivity. As part of the Dead Sea Tourist Beach, it introduces a more elevated side of the Dead Sea.

hero.alt: Salt Beach pools and blue umbrellas beside the Dead Sea

gallery.alt: Salt Beach entrance with welcome signs
Salt Beach pool framed by palm trees
Palm trees and poolside umbrellas at Salt Beach
Salt Beach entrance signs and flags
Wide view across the Salt Beach pool

approach: Blue umbrellas, palms and open views of the Dead Sea give the destination its visual character.
execution: The photographs move from the branded entrance to the pools and quiet spaces along the shore.
results: Together, the images show Salt Beach as a distinct place within the wider Dead Sea destination.

brand: Derived from the Latin-inspired root "elevare," meaning "to elevate" or "to lift up," Lévo embodies the art of refinement and transformation.
From the morning ritual of a perfectly brewed coffee to the quiet joy of a well-crafted pastry, Lévo celebrates the beauty found in everyday indulgences.

hero.alt: LÉVO Café terrace and entrance surrounded by greenery

banner.alt: Black-and-white photograph of the LÉVO Café storefront

gallery.alt: Coffee being poured into a LÉVO Café cup
LÉVO drink and pastry on a table
Fresh croissants served at LÉVO Café
LÉVO takeaway coffee and baguette
Stack of white LÉVO Café cups

approach: The visual story stays close to the café ritual: coffee, pastries and the moments between them.
execution: Storefront and product photography bring LÉVO’s name into the space and onto its cups.
results: The collection connects the café itself with the food and drinks people come to enjoy.

brand: InCharge is a network of trusted maintenance experts, bringing skilled hands and dependable service to everyday needs.
They simplify repairs, cleaning, and upkeep by connecting people with professionals who show up, care, and get it done right.

hero.alt: INCHARGE fleet concept with white lettering on an orange service van

gallery.alt: INCHARGE workwear concept: charcoal jacket with an orange branded back panel
INCHARGE orange canvas tool-roll concept with three maintenance tools
INCHARGE offices campaign graphic
INCHARGE clinics campaign graphic
INCHARGE residential buildings campaign graphic
INCHARGE retail stores campaign graphic
Before and after interior renovation with INCHARGE branding

approach: Orange, charcoal and white give the maintenance identity a clear, practical visual language.
execution: Fleet, workwear and tool-roll concepts carry the identity into everyday maintenance, alongside the supplied facility campaign.
results: A consistent visual language across vehicles, textiles and the spaces the brand serves.

brand: DWEGO is a dynamic and innovative sportswear brand aimed at those who seek both performance and style.
The name suggests motion, energy, and a sense of forward momentum, capturing the essence of athleticism and the drive to excel.

hero.alt: DWEGO movement campaign with three athletes

gallery.alt: DWEGO sportswear campaign on a blue court
DWEGO summer sportswear campaign
DWEGO grey outfit campaign layout
DWEGO activewear campaign in pink
DWEGO summer campaign in red sportswear

approach: Movement, confident poses and strong colour carry the sportswear story.
execution: The supplied campaign layouts pair athletes with short headlines and clear product focus.
results: The series gives DWEGO a consistent look across several outfits and settings.

brand: D-Tale tells the story of its name: the "D" honors the Daraghmeh family, and "Tale" celebrates the journey shared with every customer.
From that idea, the visual identity is built around one simple truth: details matter.

hero.alt: DTALE store entrance with arched doorways and bilingual signage

gallery.alt: DTALE storefront with illuminated lettering and clothing displays
DTALE formal office outfits campaign

approach: The supplied images bring the fashion and the physical store into one story.
execution: A formal outfit campaign sits alongside a photograph of the DTALE storefront.
results: Together, they show the brand in both its campaign and retail setting.

brand: A refined destination where nature, wellness, and serenity come together on the shores of the Dead Sea.
Inspired by the world's lowest point and its timeless beauty, it creates experiences that restore balance and awaken the senses.

hero.alt: I love Dead Sea sign at the Tourist Beach

gallery.alt: Jordanian flag above the Dead Sea shore
Dead Sea Tourist Beach logo on a building
Shade umbrellas along the Dead Sea shore
Colourful play area at Dead Sea Tourist Beach
Bilingual welcome sign at Dead Sea Tourist Beach

approach: Shoreline views and recognizable arrival points introduce the place before its details.
execution: The photographs show the beach, welcome signage, amenities and family spaces.
results: The collection presents a fuller view of the destination, from entrance to water’s edge.

brand: OLVY presents soaps and body care in a palette of greens, warm neutrals and natural textures.

hero.alt: OLVY body care product among green leaves

gallery.alt: OLVY soap bars in several colours
Hands holding OLVY soap bars
OLVY bottle framed by pink stone
OLVY bottle and lemons in a woven bag
OLVY packaged products on a wooden table
OLVY soap bars among rose petals

approach: Natural light, plants and tactile surfaces echo the “Rooted in Nature” line.
execution: The images move between the soaps, bottled products and ingredients used in the styling.
results: The product range reads as one visual family across the supplied photographs.

brand: A public space on the northern Dead Sea shore, with shaded paths, places to sit and views over the water.

hero.alt: I love Dead Sea sign on the Corniche promenade

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How partt handles website inquiries, personal information, and your privacy choices.
privacy.introduction: A clear explanation of the information you share with us and how it is used.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: partt agency is a strategic marketing agency based in Amman, Jordan. This policy covers website inquiries and the personal information handled through our website. Our contact address for inquiries and privacy requests is info@parttagency.com.
A client project may involve additional information and separate contractual arrangements. Where that happens, the relevant agreement and any additional privacy information also apply.

sections.title: Information you share
paragraphs: When you use the project inquiry form, we ask for your name, email address, and a description of your project. You can also choose to provide your company or brand, phone number, the service you need, and an approximate budget.

If you contact us by email or phone, we receive the information you include in that conversation. Please share only what is relevant to your inquiry, and avoid sending passwords, payment-card details, or sensitive personal information through the form.
The form displays whether delivery succeeds. If delivery fails or the form is unavailable, please contact us directly rather than assuming your message reached our team.

sections.title: How information is used
paragraphs: We use inquiry information to read and respond to your message, understand your project, prepare a requested proposal, and communicate about services you ask us to provide.
Submitting a project inquiry does not subscribe you to a newsletter. If we want to use your information for a separate purpose that needs your permission, we will request that permission separately.

sections.title: Website data & storage
paragraphs: Our website does not currently use analytics tools, advertising pixels, or visitor accounts. Project inquiry submissions are not stored in a website database.

If you choose to turn animations on despite a reduced-motion device setting, your browser remembers that choice in local storage. That preference is read on your device and is not sent with a project inquiry. Our Cookie Policy explains how to clear it.

Delivering the website involves technical connection information, such as an IP address, browser information, the requested page, and the time of a request. Website and email providers may process that information to deliver their services and maintain security.

sections.title: Service providers
paragraphs: Website hosting, email, and message-delivery providers may process the information needed to operate the site and deliver inquiries. Details are shared with the people at partt who need them to respond to your request.
We do not sell contact-form submissions or publish them. Information may be disclosed when required by applicable law or a lawful request from a competent authority.

A provider may process information outside Jordan. Any transfer must meet the requirements that apply to that transfer. You can contact us for details about the providers and processing locations relevant to your inquiry.

sections.title: Retention & security
paragraphs: We retain inquiry correspondence while it is needed to handle your request and any resulting working relationship, or for a period required by applicable law. We delete or anonymize information when it is no longer needed.

We limit access to inquiry information to the people and providers who need it for those purposes. No website or email service can promise absolute security; please use an agreed secure channel for confidential project materials.

sections.title: Your privacy choices
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you can request access to your personal information, a correction, deletion or anonymization, a restriction on processing, or a transferable copy. You can also object to qualifying processing and withdraw consent where processing relies on it.

Send your request to info@parttagency.com. We may need enough information to confirm your identity and locate the relevant correspondence. If a legal requirement affects what we can do, we will explain it.
You may also raise a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Directorate at Jordan’s Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when the website or our data-handling practices change. The date at the top identifies the latest version. A change to this notice does not itself provide consent for a new use of your information.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: The cookies and browser storage used by the partt website, and how to manage your preferences.
cookies.introduction: What this website remembers in your browser, why it matters, and how you stay in control.

sections.title: Cookies & local storage
paragraphs: Cookies are small values stored by a browser that can be sent back to a website with later requests. Local storage also saves information in your browser, but it is not automatically sent to the server with each request.
This policy describes the storage used by the partt website. A separate website you visit through a link has its own policies.

sections.title: What we currently use
paragraphs: The website uses a local-storage preference to remember an animation choice. We do not currently set analytics or advertising cookies or run advertising pixels.
You can browse the website without accepting advertising or analytics tracking because those tools are not currently used here.

sections.title: Your motion preference
paragraphs: Name: not-used-by-this-static-site. Storage type: local storage. Purpose: remember when you select “Turn motion on” after your device has requested reduced motion.

This preference contains the value “on”. It does not contain your name, email, or a visitor identifier, and the website does not send it to partt. It remains in that browser until its site data is cleared or the browser removes it.
If you have not made that choice, the site follows your device’s motion preference without saving an override.

sections.title: Managing your choice
paragraphs: Use your browser’s site-data controls to remove the saved motion preference. Clearing data for this website resets the override, so the website will follow your device’s reduced-motion setting again.

You can also restrict cookies and browser storage in your browser settings. Cookie controls and local-storage controls may be separate. The website remains readable when storage is unavailable, although it may not remember your animation choice on a later visit.

sections.title: Other websites & tools
paragraphs: The website serves its fonts and project images from the site rather than embedding an external font service. Links to external websites open services with their own storage and privacy practices.

sections.title: Future changes
paragraphs: If we introduce analytics, advertising, or other optional storage, we will update this policy and provide the information and choices required before using those tools. The date at the top shows when this policy was last updated.
For information about project inquiries and your personal information, please read our Privacy Policy or contact us using the details below.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Terms for using the partt website, viewing our work, and sending a project inquiry.
terms.introduction: Simple terms for exploring our website, viewing our work, and starting a conversation.

sections.title: About this website
paragraphs: partt agency operates this website to introduce our services and show selected work. These terms relate to use of the website. Please use it lawfully and respect the rights described below.
You can browse without creating an account or making a purchase. A project inquiry starts a conversation; it does not by itself create a service agreement or commit either party to a project.

sections.title: Responsible use
paragraphs: When using the website, please do not:
items: Try to access private systems, accounts, or information without permission.
Introduce malicious code, disrupt the website, or use the inquiry form for spam or deceptive messages.
Submit material you have no right to share, or use the website to infringe another person’s rights.

sections.title: Our work & other rights
paragraphs: The website includes branding, writing, designs, photographs, and project materials belonging to partt, our clients, or other rights holders. Client names and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.

Viewing a case study does not transfer ownership or grant a commercial license. Please obtain the relevant permission before reproducing or using protected materials, except where applicable law permits that use.

sections.title: Inquiries & proposals
paragraphs: Please provide accurate contact details and information you are authorized to share. Send only an initial project outline through the website; agree an appropriate channel with us before sharing confidential files or sensitive information.

Service scope, deliverables, fees, payment terms, timelines, confidentiality, and ownership or licensing of project work are agreed separately in writing. Website descriptions and portfolio examples do not replace that agreement.
If a signed project agreement addresses the same matter, its project-specific provisions apply to that engagement.

sections.title: Information & availability
paragraphs: We aim to keep website information accurate and useful, but content and service descriptions may change. Past work and results illustrate particular projects; they are not a promise of the same outcome for another project.
Website access may be interrupted for maintenance or technical reasons. Please confirm any information material to a project directly with our team before relying on it for a business decision.

sections.title: External links & privacy
paragraphs: Links to another website are provided for reference. We do not operate those websites, and their own terms and privacy policies apply when you visit them.
Our Privacy Policy explains how website inquiries and personal information are handled. Our Cookie Policy explains the motion preference stored in your browser.

sections.title: Applicable law
paragraphs: These website terms are governed by the laws of Jordan, subject to any mandatory rights that apply to you. Nothing in these terms excludes a right or responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded.
If you have a concern about the website, please contact us so we can try to resolve it. Any separate project agreement may contain its own provisions for handling project disputes.

sections.title: Updates to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these website terms as the site changes. The date at the top identifies the current version. Changes to website terms do not amend a separately signed project agreement.
